free_tier_limits: Free Forever plan includes product quotas (e.g. 10k series Prometheus metrics, 50 GB logs, 50 GB traces, 3 users; limits change — see pricing). Cloud API itself has no separate free-call quota published.
rate_limits: Cloud API enforces rate limits and may return HTTP 429; specific numeric limits are not published as a single public quota table — check Cloud API docs and response headers.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: B correct — original 'unknown' is wrong; Grafana pricing Free Forever publishes product quotas (https://grafana.com/pricing/). rate_limits: B partly correct — original 'not published' understates that Cloud API docs describe rate limiting/429 behavior (https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/developer-resources/api-reference/cloud-api/); numeric caps still not a clear public table. example: B correct — list orgs is GET /api/orgs with Bearer token; response is a JSON array of orgs, not {"orgs":[]} (same Cloud API docs).
